summary: Iteration 14 (frontend-only) — Home screen for ORA Iter12 (Focus Now + Perché adesso? + Action Center + Daily card + Dopo list) validated end-to-end on the web preview (viewport 390x844, iOS mobile). Login demo@ora.app / Demo!2026 succeeds via 'Continua con Email' → tab Home renders without JS console errors and without any red screen. All 12 requested test areas PASS. FocusNowCard shows title 'Esci tra 25 minuti.', description, italic human_summary box with brand left-border, 4 meta chips (Durata 2 min / Impatto Medio / Rimando Alto / Confidenza Media), status pill 'Da fare'. 'Perché adesso?' (testID why-now-btn) opens sheet-why displaying the human_summary as title, rule labels fully translated to Italian ('Evento imminente', 'Urgenza elevata', 'Importanza elevata', 'Attività rapida', 'Collegata a un viaggio', 'Tempo disponibile', 'Rischio elevato se rimandata') — grep on the sheet body confirmed ZERO raw ids ('imminent_event', 'context_shift', 'high_impact_task', 'urgent_deadline' all absent) — plus 'Cosa la rende prioritaria', 'Passi del ragionamento', 'Stime', 'Dati utilizzati' sections (rendered UPPERCASE via CSS textTransform, which caused a false negative in initial substring check but confirmed present in DOM screenshot). Action Center: btn-start/btn-complete/btn-partial/btn-postpone/btn-more all present with 44+px min touch targets; btn-complete opens sheet-confirm containing btn-confirm; btn-partial opens sheet-partial with 25/50/75 tabs; btn-postpone opens sheet-postpone with 'Più tardi oggi', 'Domani', 'Weekend' options; btn-more opens sheet-more with Cronologia/Blocca/Ignora; Cronologia opens sheet-history — action labels there are also Italian-translated (no raw start/complete/partial/postpone/block/dismiss tokens). Daily card testID daily-card shows 100/100 pill in success color (green, score>=66), 3 meta chips (0 eventi / 0h occupate / Energia alta), first-free-slot line '08:00–22:00', opportunity chips ('Pomeriggio libero', 'Serata libera'), 'Vedi giornata' link opens sheet-daily. 'Dopo' section text present (though this demo user's other decisions may not have surfaced as active — Focus Now is the only visible active one, later cards populated only when >1 active decision exists). Empty state empty-calendar rendered ('Collega Google Calendar') because the demo user has no calendar connected — expected. Offline handling: `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline'))` + navigator.onLine=false override → offline-banner appeared with cloud-offline icon + warning styling + header meta switched from 'Aggiornato ora' (green dot) to 'Offline' (warning dot). Zero console errors, zero pageerrors during the entire flow. All required testIDs (home-safe, home-scroll, focus-card, daily-card, why-now-btn, btn-start/complete/partial/postpone/more/daily-detail, sheet-why/daily/confirm/partial/postpone/reason/more/history, empty-calendar, offline-banner, btn-confirm) are correctly wired.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx is 1155 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold guideline. Recommend main agent split into per-section components (FocusNowCard, DailyCard, LaterCard, all *Sheet components, styles) into /app/frontend/src/components/home/*.tsx to keep the file focused. Not blocking this iteration.

Feature-flag degradation (§12) is coded correctly: on GET /explanation returning 404 with detail containing 'abilitata', flags.explain is set false and the 'Perché adesso?' button is hidden (line 108-118 in index.tsx). Same pattern for action-center on /history returning 404 with 'abilitato'. Could not exercise live because backend has flags ON — code inspection only.

runAction (line 130-160) has robust error-to-Italian-message mapping (403/404/409/5xx/network) and shows error-banner without crashing — verified pattern is sound; live 409 path not directly exercised because the demo focus decision was in 'Da fare' state at test time.

useOnlineStatus + isNetworkError isolation: markOffline is only triggered when ALL 3 initial batch requests fail with network-y errors (line 92-98) — good, prevents flapping when only one endpoint is down. Offline banner correctly listens to window 'offline'/'online' events on web.
Skeleton loading (FocusSkeleton/DailySkeleton/LaterSkeleton) render only on initial load; refresh path uses silent=true so no skeleton flash — verified in code (line 82-83).
All interactive elements have testID + accessibilityRole='button' + accessibilityLabel + hitSlop:8 or minHeight:tokens.touch.min (44). Touch target compliance is met.
Sheet component uses statusBarTranslucent, animated backdrop + SlideInDown+springify — smooth open/close verified visually. Backdrop Pressable properly closes on outside tap.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 12 requested test areas PASS (login flow, FocusNowCard render, why-now sheet + translated labels, all 5 action buttons + their sheets, MoreMenu + HistorySheet with translated USER_ACTION_LABELS, DailyCard + threshold color + sheet-daily, later section presence, empty-calendar state, offline-banner + header meta, no JS console errors, accessibility labels + 44px touch targets, feature-flag hide code-verified).

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing demo@ora.app with its 5 pre-seeded priority cards from registration. No decisions were mutated (all action sheets were only opened + closed, not confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter12 Home is production-ready on web preview. To reproduce: navigate http://localhost:3000/ → 'Continua con Email' → demo@ora.app / Demo!2026 → home-safe appears within 3s with focus-card + daily-card + empty-calendar. All sheets (why/confirm/partial/postpone/reason/more/history/daily) are behind Pressable buttons with testIDs — click force=True to open, Escape or click backdrop to close. To trigger offline banner: `await page.evaluate("() => { Object.defineProperty(navigator,'onLine',{get:()=>false,configurable:true}); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline')); }")`. Later cards only render when activeDecisions.length > 1 — on demo user only 1 is currently active after seed, so 'Dopo' section may not always show cards (empty is expected). If a future iteration needs to force the empty-focus state, delete/complete/dismiss all 5 seeded decisions via API. index.tsx at 1155 lines is a good candidate for refactor into /app/frontend/src/components/home/*.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects. One false-negative in the automation script (case-sensitive substring check on 'Cosa la rende prioritaria' when the rendered DOM shows the section header uppercased via CSS textTransform) was corrected by visual inspection of the screenshot which clearly shows 'COSA LA RENDE PRIORITARIA' and 'PASSI DEL RAGIONAMENTO' sections populated with translated Italian content.
